reason: I'd take the free six-week test because it costs me nothing and my team is already drowning in the open-PO spreadsheet. I have no budget line for $2,000 a month this year, so I'd need to see it pay back fast before I could argue for it to finance.
objection: It's one more tool sitting on top of two ERPs and my Excel tracker, and I can't tell yet whether it catches shortages my team wouldn't have caught anyway.
would_change_my_mind: Proof from the free test that it flags shortages and backorders my team missed before they hit work orders, with a dollar number I can take to finance.
